 Sixers at Cavaliers: NBA Cup Preview, Injury Report and How to Watch 11/6/2026
 Matt Murphy November 6, 2026 8:03 AM EST The Philadelphia 76ers (8-1), owners of a five-game winning streak and the NBA’s best record, will visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4) on Friday in an Emirates NBA Cup group-play game. Tipoff is set for 7:30 p.m. EST at Rocket Arena in Cleveland.
 The Sixers defeated the Detroit Pistons, 112-106, Wednesday on the road. Jaylen Brown scored a game-high 30 points on 11-of-19 shooting from the field, 3-for-5 from 3-point range and 5-for-7 from the free-throw line. Joel Embiid notched a double-double with 26 points and a season-high 15 rebounds.
 The Cavaliers lost to the Oklahoma City Thunder, 124-116, also on Wednesday on the road. Donovan Mitchell scored 27 points, but Oklahoma City’s Shai Gilgeous-Alexander answered with a game-high 42 after scoring 43 against Cleveland two nights earlier.
 Here are the RAV4 Things to Know ahead of Friday’s game:
 First Meeting 
 On Oct. 22, the Sixers overcame a 29-point deficit against Cleveland, the largest comeback in franchise history during the play-by-play era and LeBron James’ NBA career.
 Tyrese Maxey and Donovan Mitchell each scored 32 points in Philadelphia’s 114-106 victory.
 NBA Cupdate 
 At 1-0 in Emirates NBA Cup play, Philadelphia sits second in East Group B on point differential, while Cleveland will play its first Cup game of the season.
 On the Road Again 
 The 8-1 Sixers are 4-0 on the road to start a season for the first time since 2000-01.
 Tonight’s Uniforms 
 With home teams wearing Statement Edition uniforms and road teams wearing Association Edition uniforms during NBA Cup games, the Cavaliers will wear black and the Sixers will wear white.
 Injury Report 
 76ers 
 Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain) - Doubtful
 Dominick Barlow (low back stress reaction) - Out
 Ariel Hukporti (right Achilles tendon rupture/tear) - Out
 Cavaliers 
 Jarrett Allen (right knee contusion) - Questionable
 Tyrese Proctor (left ankle sprain) - Questionable
 Peyton Watson (right hamstring injury management) - Questionable
 Nae’Qwan Tomlin (low back stress reaction) - Out
 Jaylon Tyson (right ankle sprain) - Out
 Quote to Note 
 LeBron James on the Sixers’ chemistry:
 “We have a good team. Guys vibe with one another. Guys like each other. Guys enjoy being around each other. It makes the game a lot easier when you enjoy being around people.”
 How to Watch and Listen 
 Date: Friday, Nov. 6
 Time: 7:30 p.m. EST
 Location: Rocket Arena, Cleveland
 TV : Prime Video, NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Radio : 97.5 The Fanatic, 76ers Mobile App
